notes.batch_pattern: All 15 items processed in one continuous session with mid-point QC. Three logical batches (5+5+5) with embedded governance checks.
notes.key_observation: Many Section B items had already been upgraded to high-quality content blocks in S70-S73 but metadata blocks carried stale cognitive levels and wrong-topic EW text. S74 primarily authored matching EW text and synced cognitive levels.
notes.dl016_impact: Pack D dual-block architecture means metadata block EW fields describe different items' choices than the content block. Every metadata sync required verifying CorrectChoice from the paired content block.
